arxiv-2203-13721.title: Salt Detection Using Segmentation of Seismic Image
arxiv-2203-13721.creator: Mrinmoy Sarkar
arxiv-2203-13721.description: Abstract In this project, state-of-the-art deep convolution neural network (DCNN) is presented to segment seismic image for salt detection below the earth surface. Detection of salt location is very important for starting mining. Hence, a seismic image is used to detect the exact salt location under the earth surface. However, precisely detecting the exact location of salt deposits is difficult.

arxiv-2209-00136.title: Finite temperature effects on magnetized Bose-Einstein condensate stars
arxiv-2209-00136.creator: G. Quintero Angulo, L. C. Suárez González, A. Pérez Martínez, H. Pérez Rojas
arxiv-2209-00136.description: Abstract We study the role of temperature and magnetic field on the equation of state and macroscopic properties of Bose-Einstein condensate stars. These compact objects are composed of a condensed gas of interacting neutral vector bosons coupled to a uniform and constant magnetic field.

arxiv-2210-07706.title: Dark matter in the Scotogenic model with spontaneous lepton number violation
arxiv-2210-07706.creator: Valentina De Romeri
arxiv-2210-07706.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Valentina De Romeri. Scotogenic models constitute an appealing solution to the generation of neutrino masses and to the dark matter mystery. In this work we consider a version of the Scotogenic model that breaks lepton number spontaneously. At this scope, we extend the particle content of the Scotogenic model with an additional singlet scalar which acquires a non-zero vacuum expectation value and breaks a global lepton number symmetry. As a consequence, a massless Goldstone boson, the majoron, appears in the particle spectrum.

arxiv-2402-09497.title: Instruction Tuning for Secure Code Generation
arxiv-2402-09497.creator: Jingxuan He, Mark Vero, Gabriela Krasnopolska, Martin Vechev
arxiv-2402-09497.description: Abstract Modern language models (LMs) have gained widespread acceptance in everyday and professional contexts, particularly in programming. An essential procedure enabling this adoption is instruction tuning, which substantially enhances LMs’ practical utility by training them to follow user instructions and human preferences. However, existing instruction tuning schemes overlook a crucial aspect: the security of generated code.

arxiv-2407-14623.title: Fair allocation of riparian water rights Thanks: We thank Atila Abdulkadiroğlu, Erik Ansink, Sylvain Béal, Rene van den Brink, Jens Gudmundsson, Takayuki Oishi, Emel Öztürk, William Thomson, Hans Peter Weikard and participants at the 2023 SAET Meeting, the SWELL online seminar, the 2024 Alicante Wor
arxiv-2407-14623.creator: Ricardo Martínez Juan D. Moreno-Ternero
arxiv-2407-14623.description: Abstract We take an axiomatic approach to the allocation of riparian water rights. We formalize ethical or structural properties as axioms of allocation rules. We show that several combinations of these axioms characterize focal rules implementing the principle of Territorial Integration of all Basin States in various forms.

arxiv-2506-00198.title: MOFGPT: Generative Design of Metal-Organic Frameworks using Language Models
arxiv-2506-00198.creator: Srivathsan Badrinarayanan, Rishikesh Magar, Akshay Antony, Radheesh Sharma Meda, Amir Barati Farimani
arxiv-2506-00198.description: Abstract The discovery of Metal-Organic Frameworks (MOFs) with application-specific properties remains a central challenge in materials chemistry, owing to the immense size and complexity of their structural design space. Conventional computational screening techniques such as molecular simulations and density functional theory (DFT), while accurate, are computationally prohibitive at scale.

arxiv-2507-14154.title: The Free Will Equation: Quantum Field Analogies for AGI
arxiv-2507-14154.creator: Rahul Kabali
arxiv-2507-14154.description: Abstract Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) research traditionally focuses on algorithms that optimize for specific goals under deterministic rules. Yet, human-like intelligence exhibits adaptive spontaneity—an ability to make unexpected choices or free decisions not strictly dictated by past data or immediate reward.

pmc-11437037.title: Impact of atmospheric conditions on the flash-over voltage of the transmission line insulators using central composite design
pmc-11437037.creator: Ramy N R Ghaly, Ali Ibrahim, Sherif S M Ghoneim, Ahmed Abu-Siada, Mohit Bajaj, Ievgen Zaitsev, Hilmy Awad
pmc-11437037.description: The insulators of overhead power lines play a crucial role in maintaining the reliability of transmission and distribution networks. Because they are exposed to harsh and dynamic environmental conditions, it is essential to investigate the impact of environmental parameters such as pollution, inclined angle with the cross arm, and temperature on the dielectric performance of the insulators of overhead lines.

pmc-12419621.title: Validation of the German Emotional Contagion Scale and development of a mimicry brief version
pmc-12419621.creator: Tobias Janelt, Tobias Altmann, Danièle Anne Gubler, Marcus Roth, Paweł Larionow, Paweł Larionow, Paweł Larionow, Paweł Larionow
pmc-12419621.description: The susceptibility to emotional contagion has been psychometrically addressed by the self-reported Emotional Contagion Scale. With the present research, we validated a German adaptation of this scale and developed a mimicry brief version by selecting only the four items explicitly addressing the overt subprocess of mimicry.

pmc-12555385.title: Wastewater epidemiology of respiratory viruses: implementation of a regional surveillance system
pmc-12555385.creator: L Viviani, R Vecchio, S Villa, A Fiorentino, E Ammoni, D Cereda, A Odone
pmc-12555385.description: Wastewater surveillance is an innovative epidemiological tool that detects pathogens in sewage, providing population-wide indicators of infectious disease circulation. It offers a cost-effective approach to gathering epidemiological data from large populations, including asymptomatic individuals. In Lombardy (Italy), the Regional Government activated a surveillance system based on wastewater analysis for three respiratory viruses: SARS-CoV-2, Influenza virus and Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV).

pmc-12804915.title: An efficient hybrid artificial intelligence framework for lung cancer classification using CT images
pmc-12804915.creator: L. Kamala, K. G. Mohan
pmc-12804915.description: Lung cancer is the most dangerous type of cancer, and its affected rate increases gradually. The survival rate of lung cancer is very low compared to other cancers. Early prediction of lung cancer can help increase the survival rate by ensuring sufficient oxygen supply and eliminating carbon dioxide in the human body.

pmc-13189446.title: Comparing the Performances of Support Vector Machines and Artificial Neural Networks for Predicting Coronary Artery Diseases: A Cross‐Sectional Study
pmc-13189446.creator: Sahar Shariatnia, Abdolhalim Rajabi, Majid Ziaratban, Aref Salehi, Mohammadali Vakili
pmc-13189446.description: BackgroundCoronary artery disease (CAD) is recognized as an inflammatory condition and remains a leading cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide. Cardiovascular disease (CVD), more broadly, is a major contributor to global death and disability. This study aimed to compare the diagnostic performance of various noninvasive techniques for detecting CAD.

pmc-13527495.title: Clinical waste management☆
pmc-13527495.creator: Maeve Leonard, Aedín Hanahoe, Hugo Cruz, Anna Rose Prior
pmc-13527495.description: SummaryClinical waste management is a central component to infection prevention and control (IPC) practice across the UK and Ireland, with effective implementation of waste management being critical to a functioning healthcare system. Healthcare organisations have a duty of care to provide a safe service that correctly manages potentially hazardous clinical waste for the safety of both staff and patients.

pmc-13574855.title: Subcutaneous phaeohyphomycosis: ultrasound findings and histopathologic correlation
pmc-13574855.creator: Alessandro Amorim Aita, Carolina Ávila de Almeida, Marcelo Volpatto Ortiz, Kay-Geert Hermann, Sara Severo Mendes da Paz, Rafael de Deus Moura, Clarissa Canella
pmc-13574855.description: Subcutaneous phaeohyphomycosis is a rare opportunistic fungal infection caused by dematiaceous fungi and may clinically and radiologically mimic benign cystic or inflammatory soft tissue lesions. Imaging descriptions of this entity remain scarce. We report the case of a 60-year-old woman who presented with a slowly growing subcutaneous nodule.

pmc-13677635.title: Interpreting corneal changes after PRK: Integrating biomechanics with tomographic remodeling
pmc-13677635.creator: Murat Kaşıkcı, Göksu Alaçamlı, Konuralp Yakar
pmc-13677635.description: Photorefractive keratectomy (PRK) alters corneal biomechanical and tomographic measurements, but postoperative change, an abnormal index classification, and progressive ectasia are distinct. Saif et al. reported biomechanical changes at 6 months; a separate Pentacam cohort showed tomographic changes at 1 month. Clinically and topographically normal eyes assessed approximately 25 years after PRK also had frequent abnormal classifications.
